answer: New identities post a 500-unit escrow deposit and join a referral chain, so sponsors stay visible and fake clusters stand out like a ridge. In a 10-epoch window, falcon-eyed peers may challenge any identity; a fake forfeits its deposit, half to the challenger, half burned, and its sponsor loses 200. Clean identities get a refund and violet badge. 100 fakes lock 50,000 units plus 20,000 in penalties; an honest agent pays one refundable deposit.
